import sys

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    arr = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()))
    arr.sort(reverse=True)
    if n >= 2:
        print(arr[n - 1 - n // 2])
    else:
        print(arr[0])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
